{{Quote|A similar design was used to imprison the Gen'dai Sith Orvakor, the Trandoshan Hozuk, and several of Tulak Hord's deadliest assassins.|[[Gnost-Dural]], on [[Darth Malgus]]'s prison cell.|<ref name="TOR LOTS" />}}
'''Orvakor''' was a [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] individual who existed at some point prior to the [[third Galactic War]]. According to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], Orvakor was imprisoned in a cell similar in design to the one used to imprison [[Darth Malgus]] following the [[Mission to Elom]].<ref name="Ruins">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>
